general: Every show listed is a followed show (the follow list is the superset).
A field is omitted from a show entry when the cache held no value for it.
'watched' and 'status_category' are complete for all followed shows, taken from TV Time's own per-show status.
'watched_episode_count' / 'aired_episode_count' were only cached for some shows (favorites and recently-opened shows); where present they are the authoritative totals.

'watched_episodes' (SxxEyy) could only be recovered for shows whose episode list was cached, and usually covers only the most recent season(s) — see 'watched_episodes_partial'. 'last_watched_episode' is the furthest-watched episode for those shows.
No favorite or watched movies were present in the cache (the favorite-movies list was empty).

fields.id: Numeric show id (TheTVDB series id, as used by TV Time).
fields.name: Show title.
fields.followed: true if the show is in your Following list. Every recovered show is followed.
fields.favorited: true if the show is in your 'Favorite Shows' list.
fields.watched: true if you have started watching it (status_category up_to_date / continuing / stopped); false if only followed or saved (not_started_yet / watch_later).
fields.status_category: TV Time's own per-show status: up_to_date = caught up on every aired episode; continuing = watching, in progress; stopped = started then dropped; not_started_yet = followed but not begun; watch_later = saved to watch later.
fields.show_status: Airing status of the show itself: 'Continuing' or 'Ended'.
fields.network: Network / streamer that airs the show. Present only for shows whose episodes were cached.
fields.country: Country of origin as an ISO code (e.g. US, GB, IT).
fields.followed_at_date: When you started following the show, as a full ISO 8601 timestamp (date + time, UTC).
fields.last_watched_date: Your most recent watch activity for the show, as a full ISO 8601 timestamp (date + time). Omitted for shows you never watched.
fields.watched_episode_count: Episodes you have watched (authoritative total). Present only for shows whose counts were cached.
fields.aired_episode_count: Episodes aired to date. Present only where cached.
fields.is_up_to_date: true if you have watched every episode aired so far.
fields.is_archived: true if you archived the show in TV Time.
fields.is_for_later: true if the show is flagged to watch later.
fields.last_watched_episode: Furthest episode you have watched, as an SxxEyy code. Present only for shows with per-episode detail.
fields.watched_episodes: Individually-recovered watched episodes as SxxEyy codes (a list in JSON; a single comma-separated column in the CSV). May be incomplete — see watched_episodes_partial.
fields.watched_episodes_partial: true when the watched_episodes list is smaller than watched_episode_count, i.e. the cache only stored some (usually the latest) seasons. Absent when the list appears complete.
fields.hashtag: TV Time social hashtag for the show.
fields.favorited_at_date: When you added the show to Favorites, as a full ISO 8601 timestamp (date + time, UTC). Present only for favorited shows.
